title: Scientific Communication and Quantitative Medical Evidence
purpose: Communicate anatomy/physiology claims using evidence, format, voice, tone, and quantitative reasoning.
required_visual_model_data: Medical data table; graph; communication rubric/checklist

direct_resource.Title: NIH MedlinePlus: Understanding Medical Research
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the medical research page. Observe how medical claims should be evaluated. Record the claim, evidence type, data display, and one question that checks reliability.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
